description: This file defines the ConnectionTimeoutException class, a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto project to represent timeout errors during connection operations. It includes methods for constructing instances from messages or JSON objects, and provides a builder for mutable instantiation.

classes.name: ConnectionTimeoutException
classes.description: Custom exception class representing connection timeout errors. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ConnectivityException, providing multiple constructors and static factory methods for creating instances, including support for JSON deserialization.

classes.name: ConnectionTimeoutException.Builder
classes.description: Builder class enabling mutable, fluent creation of ConnectionTimeoutException instances, allowing customization of headers, message, description, cause, and hyperlink.

methods.name: ConnectionTimeoutException.fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a ConnectionTimeoutException with a specific message and headers.

methods.name: ConnectionTimeoutException.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ConnectionTimeoutException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: ConnectionTimeoutException.setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: Builder
methods.description: Builder class for constructing ConnectionTimeoutException objects with optional customization.
